type: synthetic sensor/game and shared-board UI integration tests

results.name: Concurrent motion events cannot overwrite fresh orientation readings
Starting posture calibrates to neutral and does not auto-climb
Positive/negative physical tilts climb right/left stairs
Neutral jitter does not move character
Gravity fallback has the same sign as orientation in all screen rotations
Orientation handles both landscape directions and upside-down portrait
Invalid, null, NaN and missing readings never activate sensors
Stale readings stop movement; reconnection recalibrates
Restart resets tilt, cooldown and neutral state
Screen rotation pauses and recalibrates
No-signal timeout leaves manual controls usable
Both permission requests start within the initial click; partial grant works
Denied permissions show fallback status
Downloaded Android files and insecure origins explain HTTPS instead of retrying
Reconnect does not register duplicate event handlers
Keyboard arrows work and repeated keydown is ignored
Swipe release does not create a second step; pointer cancellation clears state
Calibration pauses stamina and background tabs do not advance game
Blocked local storage does not break start or game over
Shared board renders server rows and explicitly shows real empty state
Shared board network failures have a retry state, never fake sample rows
Public scores are submitted only after explicit form action, using this finished run
Failed public registration keeps the original score available to retry
Local files explain that shared scores require the online game
